title.zh: Iran eases currency rules to bypass US sanctions with crypto: Report
title.en: Iran eases currency rules to bypass US sanctions with crypto: Report

current_state.zh: Iran's central bank has reportedly eased foreign currency controls to encourage businesses to use cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Tether to bypass US sanctions and settle cross-border transactions.
